new.md:
Creates a new empty "every" filter.

Use [`MultiFilter.append()`](xref:gtk:Gtk.MultiFilter#method:append) to add filters to it.

This filter matches an item if each of the filters added to it
matches the item. In particular, this means that if no filter
has been added to it, the filter matches every item.

doc.brief: Matches an item when each of its filters matches.
doc.md:
Matches an item when each of its filters matches.

To add filters to a `GtkEveryFilter`, use [`MultiFilter.append()`](xref:gtk:Gtk.MultiFilter#method:append).
